{{Quote|You two find the general and help him. This frigate is not going to last; we have to get out of here!''"<br />"''Yes, sir!|Rex, telling Koho and Denal to find Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="CoD" />}}
'''Koho''' was the nickname of a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Koho served under [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]], and participated in the [[Battle of Devaron/Legends|Battle of Devaron]] aboard the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane's]] [[Cad Bane's Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] to recover a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] that Bane had [[Raid on the Jedi Temple/Legends|stolen]]. During the fight, Rex ordered Koho and fellow [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Denal/Legends|Denal]] to find [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], who had left to pursue Bane. The two clones began searching the [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|frigate]] and soon located and confronted Bane. After the pair ordered the bounty hunter to surrender, however, the Duros [[Death/Legends|killed]] both Koho and Denal and escaped.

==Biography==
[[File:Denal_Koho.png|thumb|left|210px|Denal and Koho, before engaging Cad Bane.]]
A [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] nicknamed Koho was born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to fight for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="db" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="FF-2014 8: Geonosis" /> he participated in the [[Battle of Devaron/Legends|Battle of Devaron]]. Serving under [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]], Koho joined Rex's [[Squad/Legends|squad]] within the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] and accompanied [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], to recover a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] that had been [[Raid on the Jedi Temple/Legends|previously stolen]] by the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]]. After engaging Bane and his [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] in a [[Lightfight|firefight]] aboard his personal [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Cad Bane's Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]], Tano separated from Skywalker's group and chased after the fleeing Bane, who had the stolen holocron in his possession. Skywalker soon ordered Rex and the clone [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] to find the [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|frigate's]] [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] and secure a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] while he left to find his Padawan.<ref name="CoD" />

After finding a [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle/Legends|''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttle]] on standby inside the hangar, Rex received a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] transmission from [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] and was told to evacuate the heavily damaged [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]]. The clone [[Captain/Legends|captain]] then gave Koho and fellow trooper [[Denal/Legends|Denal]] the task of locating and assisting Skywalker. The two clones departed from the group, but while searching for the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[General/Legends|General]], they spotted Bane on top of a platform overlooking the hangar. Koho and Denal confronted Bane, and Denal told the Duros bounty hunter to surrender.<ref name="CoD" /> However, their attempt at capturing Bane was cut short when the bounty hunter [[Death/Legends|killed]] Denal<ref name="Cotf">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode203.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Children of the Force}}</ref> and Koho,<ref name="guides">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Official Episode Guide Series 1 & 2]]''</ref> stole Denal's armor,<ref name="Cotf" /> and escaped with the Republic force on board the ''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttle.<ref name="CoD" />

==Personality and traits==
As a clone of Fett,<ref name="CoD" /> Koho stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall<ref name="db" /> and had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin.<ref name="Skin" />

==Equipment==
The clone trooper wore white [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone armor]]. His helmet featured a red-colored [[Electrobinoculars/Legends|binocular visor]]. Koho wielded a [[Z-6 rotary blaster cannon/Legends|Z-6 rotary blaster cannon]].<ref name="CoD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Koho first appeared in "[[Cargo of Doom]]," the second episode in the [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, which aired on [[October 2]], [[2009]]. While the trooper was not identified in the episode, his name was revealed in the episode's accompanying [[The Clone Wars Episode Guides|online guide]].<ref name="Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode202.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Cargo of Doom}}</ref>
